name: movie_delori_lpqi_night
label: Movie: one night of delta Ori Aa1 on the LPQI-Pathfinder, the diameter from the null crossing (550 nm, MPD)
notes: 550 nm filter: its first null (1.22 lambda/theta = 430 m) lies inside the night's 330-530 m sweep; in H-alpha the null sits at the far end of the track.

Three panels: the projected NOT-TNG baseline on the uv plane with the first-null circle; the measurements walking along |V|^2(B) through the null with their per-block error bars (model curves for theta and theta +/- 5 %); the coincidence histogram accumulating over the night.
